Oh I LOVE this theme for you. “The Seen Girls” is so on-brand for your world, Bethany. It’s feminine, elevated, a little cheeky, but ultimately about confidence, visibility, and power. Let’s make the swag feel intentional, not cheesy.

Here are fun, clever, and elevated ideas organized by vibe.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
💄 ON-THEME + PLAYFUL (Mean Girls Inspired, But Luxe)  

🩷 “On Wednesdays We Wear Confidence” Tee or Tank  
Soft, elevated fabric. Neutral blush, cream, or black. Subtle branding.

💋 Compact Mirror That Says:  
• “You Are So Seen.”  
• “That’s So Fetch.” (small inside joke insert card explaining it)  
• “Check Your Crown.”  

💅 Custom Pink Lip Gloss or Lip Oil  
Label it:  
• “Gloss Boss”  
• “Seen & Shining”  
• “Main Character Energy”

📓 Mini Notebook  
Cover options:  
• “The Burn Book (But Make It Growth)”  
• “Visibility Playbook”  
• “CEO Notes Only”

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
✨ VISIBILITY + POWER (Aligned With Your Luxora Energy)  

👑 Gold or Pearl Hair Clip  
Tagline: “Crowned & Seen”

🖊 Luxury Pen  
Engraved: “Sign the Bigger Deal.”

📸 Phone Ring Light Clip  
Tag: “You’re Not Too Much. You’re Just Meant To Be Seen.”

💼 Structured Cosmetic or Tech Pouch  
Stamped: “The Seen Girls”

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
🧠 SMART + CLEVER INSERT CARDS  

You can elevate inexpensive items with powerful messaging.

Examples:

Card Title:  
“Stop Playing Small”  

Inside Copy:  
“You are not too loud. Too ambitious. Too visible. You were never meant to blend in.”

Or a fun Mean Girls nod:

“You can’t sit with us…  
Unless you’re building something iconic.”

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
🍸 FUN SOCIAL MOMENT ITEMS  

💗 Custom Pink Stanley-style Cup or Tumbler  
Label: “Sip & Scale”

🍪 Sugar Cookies with “You’re So Fetch” Icing  

🕶 Sunglasses  
Tag: “Future Looks Bright.”

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
🪩 HIGHER-END OPTIONS (If Budget Allows)  

• Custom leather card holder  
• Silk scarf in your brand colors  
• Branded portable charger  
• Mini fragrance roller called “Confidence”

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
🎀 A Clever Bag Itself  

The bag matters. Ideas:

• Clear PVC tote: “Transparency Is Power.”  
• Structured canvas tote: “Built To Be Seen.”  
• Makeup pouch: “Main Character Mode.”

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
🔥 If You Want To Go Full Theme  

You could create sections inside the bag:

“The Regina” – Bold & Strategic  
“The Cady” – Growth & Evolution  
“The Gretchen” – Voice & Messaging  
“The Karen” – Intuition & Soft Power  

It becomes interactive and memorable.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
If you tell me:
• Budget per person  
• Estimated attendee count  
• Are these med spa owners, entrepreneurs, or mixed audience?  
• Do you want luxe or playful-cute?  

I can build you a fully structured swag bag strategy with cost tiers and a sourcing list.

Perfect. That actually makes this easier.

If this is a smaller, community-driven event without a website and without big corporate backing, you want SIMPLE tiers, clear value, and low friction pricing.

No overproduction. No corporate energy. Just curated women-owned brands that align with the vibe.

Here is a clean, realistic structure for The Seen Girls.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
THE SEEN GIRLS  
Vendor Collective  

Designed for an intimate summit, 50–120 attendees.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
🌸 FEATURED VENDOR  
2–3 Spots  
$1,000  

Includes:  
• 6-foot table in prime location  
• 2 event tickets  
• 2-minute microphone introduction during event  
• Logo on printed signage  
• Social media shoutout before event  
• Swag bag placement  

This feels elevated but still approachable.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
💗 STANDARD VENDOR  
5–8 Spots  
$500–$750  

Includes:  
• Vendor table  
• 1 event ticket  
• Listed on printed signage  
• Swag bag insert  
• Group social media mention  

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
✨ SWAG BAG ONLY  
Unlimited  
$150–$300 or product donation  

Includes:  
• Insert or small product in bag  
• Mention during “Thank You to Our Vendors” moment  

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
If You Want It Even Simpler  

You could do just two tiers:

Vendor Table: $600  
Swag Only: $200  

Sometimes simple sells faster.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
If This Is Truly Grassroots  

You can also:

• Trade vendor table for providing food, florals, decor  
• Trade for photography coverage  
• Trade for coffee cart  

That keeps costs low and builds community.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
What makes vendors say yes at this price point:

• Access to high-quality women  
• Intimate networking  
• No giant expo chaos  
• Real relationship building  

That’s the value. Not website logos.

If you tell me:
• How many attendees you’re expecting  
• What city  
• What type of audience (entrepreneurs? med spa owners? mixed?)  

I can help you price this perfectly so you don’t undervalue it but also don’t overreach.

Bethany… this is SUCH a smart move.

For The Seen Girls, vendor tiers should feel elevated, intentional, and aligned with your “visibility + power + community” positioning. This is not a flea market vendor hall. This is curated partnership access.

Below is a structured, revenue-driven vendor tier model you can use immediately.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
THE SEEN GIRLS SUMMIT  
Vendor & Brand Partnership Tiers  

Positioning Line You Can Use:  
“The Seen Girls Vendor Collective is a curated group of brands committed to visibility, growth, and women building iconic businesses.”

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
🌟 PRESENTING PARTNER  
(1 Available)  
Investment: $10,000–$15,000  

This is the headline sponsor.

Included:

• “The Seen Girls Summit presented by [Brand Name]”  
• 10-minute on-stage speaking segment  
• Premium vendor booth placement at entrance  
• Logo on all marketing materials, landing page, emails  
• Logo on step-and-repeat backdrop  
• Featured in 3 pre-event email blasts  
• Dedicated Instagram Reel collaboration  
• Inclusion in VIP swag bag with premium placement  
• Access to attendee email list (opt-in only)  
• 2 VIP event tickets  
• Option to host private VIP dinner or lounge  

Who this is ideal for:  
Large aesthetic brands, tech platforms, wellness brands, financial partners.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
💎 PLATINUM PARTNER  
(3 Available)  
Investment: $5,000–$7,500  

Included:

• 5-minute spotlight on stage  
• Premium vendor booth placement  
• Logo on website and signage  
• 2 social media features  
• Inclusion in all swag bags  
• Email mention in 2 pre-event campaigns  
• 1 VIP ticket + 1 GA ticket  
• Ability to provide promo offer to attendees  

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
✨ GOLD PARTNER  
(5–8 Available)  
Investment: $2,500–$4,000  

Included:

• Vendor booth  
• Logo on website  
• 1 social media mention  
• Inclusion in swag bag  
• Email mention in one group sponsor email  
• 1 GA ticket  

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
💗 SILVER PARTNER  
(10–15 Available)  
Investment: $1,000–$1,500  

Included:

• Shared vendor table  
• Logo on sponsor slide  
• Swag bag insert (card or small product)  
• Name listed on website  

Great for smaller female-owned brands.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
🎀 SWAG BAG SPONSOR  
Unlimited  
Investment: Product-only or $500 cash  

Included:

• Product or promo insert in swag bag  
• Listed on website sponsor page  

This is your entry-level opportunity.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
🪩 ADD-ON OPPORTUNITIES (Revenue Boosters)  

You can upsell these to any tier.

• Step-and-repeat logo placement: $1,500  
• Sponsored breakout session: $2,000  
• VIP lounge branding: $3,000  
• Coffee bar sponsor: $2,500  
• Cocktail hour sponsor: $3,000  
• Branded charging station: $1,000  
• Photo booth sponsor: $2,000  

These can stack on top of tier pricing.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
💡 Positioning Strategy For You  

Given your world and audience, the best vendor categories to target:

• AI marketing tools  
• CRM platforms  
• Laser or device companies  
• Skincare brands  
• Hormone or wellness labs  
• Financing companies  
• Branding photographers  
• Business coaches  
• Luxury lifestyle brands  
• Female-focused financial planners  

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
🔥 Revenue Example (Conservative Model)

1 Presenting: $12,500  
3 Platinum: $6,000 avg = $18,000  
5 Gold: $3,000 avg = $15,000  
10 Silver: $1,250 avg = $12,500  

Total: $58,000 in vendor revenue  

That alone could fund the entire summit.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  

If you’d like, I can now create:

• A polished vendor prospectus outline  
• A sponsorship pitch email sequence  
• A vendor sales script  
• A sponsorship one-pager copy deck  
• Or a profit-maximizing vendor strategy based on expected attendance  

Tell me how many attendees you're expecting and what city this is in, and I’ll optimize this for your scale.

Love that you’re thinking about this strategically.

If this is The Seen Girls and it’s community-driven, early-stage, or intentionally intimate, your vendor tiers should feel accessible but still elevated. You want quality partners, not just whoever can write the biggest check.

Here is a revised, lower-investment tier structure that still feels premium.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
THE SEEN GIRLS SUMMIT  
Curated Vendor Collective  

Positioning line you can use:  
“A curated group of women-forward brands committed to visibility, confidence, and business growth.”

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
🌟 TITLE PARTNER  
1 Available  
Investment: $3,500–$5,000  

Included:  
• “The Seen Girls presented by [Brand]” mention on website  
• 5-minute stage acknowledgment  
• Premium booth placement  
• Logo on event page  
• 2 social media features  
• Inclusion in swag bag  
• 2 event tickets  

Perfect for a med spa vendor, local aesthetic brand, or tech platform.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
💎 SPOTLIGHT PARTNER  
3 Available  
Investment: $1,500–$2,000  

Included:  
• Vendor booth  
• Logo on website  
• 1 social media feature  
• Swag bag inclusion  
• 1 event ticket  

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
✨ COMMUNITY PARTNER  
5–10 Available  
Investment: $750–$1,000  

Included:  
• Vendor table space  
• Logo listed on sponsor slide  
• Swag bag insert  
• Shoutout during event  

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
💗 SWAG BAG FEATURE  
Unlimited  
Investment: $250–$500 or product-only  

Included:  
• Product or promo in bag  
• Listed on website  

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  
Optional Add-Ons (Easy Upsells)  

• Photo backdrop logo: $500  
• Coffee bar sponsor: $750  
• Breakout session sponsor: $1,000  
• Social media bundle: $500  

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  

Example Revenue Model (More Intimate Event)

1 Title at $4,000  
3 Spotlight at $1,750 average = $5,250  
8 Community at $900 average = $7,200  

Total vendor revenue: $16,450  

That can still cover decor, AV, speaker gifts, and swag without feeling corporate.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  

Strategically, for this vibe, I’d target:

• Local Nashville boutiques  
• Women-owned wellness brands  
• Skincare startups  
• Female financial advisors  
• Branding photographers  
• Event stylists  
• Social media managers  
• Beauty or lifestyle product founders  

Keep it curated and on-theme.

If you tell me:  
• Expected attendee count  
• Is this Nashville?  
• One-day or multi-day?  

I can fine-tune pricing so it matches your scale and feels aligned with Luxora’s positioning without overreaching.
